lines.text: Hosting a cookie swap this year? Guests sign up, so nobody bakes the same cookie. The baking math tells everyone how many to bring, for six to fifteen guests. Allergen labels for every plate. And ballots crown the best cookie. Thirteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Three big goals. Twelve weeks. Start by looking back at 2026. Score eight parts of your life, from one to ten. Pick three goals, and give each week one small milestone. Then check in every week. Fourteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
